args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged (1): r03, because a final check failed but the run was still accepted. Closure is 2.769 px/h against a 1.0 px/h threshold, yet it is marked as passed. Its profile also has a different shape from the rest of the batch: the largest flank difference is at 21 µm from the tip instead of 84 µm (z -6.38), and the growth zone is 695 µm instead of 684 µm. It was reported with the width-free ratio, so plane sections was not run.
Cleared (7): r01, r02, r07, r08 pass every check that was run, and all their summaries sit at or near the batch values. r04, r05, r06 also pass every check. Their largest flank difference is negative (-0.91 and -0.46 %/h), which the passing plane-sections check matches to the curvature rate, so these roots bend the other way. Their centre strain-rate peak (53.10 vs 53.20 %/h) and growth zone (674 vs 684 µm) differ only slightly from the batch; the |z| looks large only because the batch MAD is very small.
What the flagged run shows: there is only one, so there is no shared pattern. Its closure failure means the tip motion does not match the tracked velocity field, and the flank difference peaks in a different place.
Caveat: r04–r06 all registered their frames from 400 px from the tip. If 1 px is about 1 µm, that is inside the growth zone, which ends about 684 µm from the tip. Their checks pass, but the registration start point should be confirmed in a follow-up.
